emailVerification.title: Verify your email
emailVerification.subtitle: We've sent you a code by email. Enter it below to continue.

username.title: Username
username.subtitle: Choose a unique name for your profile. Pick any available option

birthdate.title: Date of birth
birthdate.subtitle: We only use this to personalize your experience

gender.title: Choose your gender
gender.subtitle: This helps us show you more relevant services

locationPermission.title: Location permission
locationPermission.subtitle: This helps us show you nearby services and personalize your experience

type.title: What kind of business do you have?
type.subtitle: Choose the category that best describes your business

locationDescription.title: Introduce your location
locationDescription.subtitle: Tell us your business name and share a few details about your services, atmosphere, or anything else that matters

address.title: Location address
address.subtitle: Add the address where you'll welcome clients

gallery.title: Photo gallery
gallery.subtitle: Upload a few photos to show clients what your location looks like.
gallery.skipHint: You can skip this step for now and add photos later from your business settings.

services.title: Service categories
services.subtitle: Add the services you offer at this location

schedules.title: Working hours
schedules.subtitle: Add the time slots when your location is open for clients

hasEmployees.title: Does your team take bookings?
hasEmployees.subtitle: Choose "Yes" if you have colleagues working in parallel. Each of them gets their own calendar to manage their own services and clients. If you work alone, everything will be centralized in a single business calendar.
hasEmployees.yes: YES, I have employees who take bookings
hasEmployees.no: NO, I don't have employees who take bookings

validation.title: Congrats! You've finished the setup
validation.subtitle: We've received all the details about your business. Our team will review your application and let you know as soon as your account is approved.
validation.responseTime: We usually reply in under 15 minutes
validation.nextSubtitle: Once your location is validated, you'll be able to add your team so they can take bookings. Here's how it works:

employeeAccount.title: Employee account
employeeAccount.description: Your colleague creates a simple user account in the app.

invitation.title: Your invitation
invitation.description: You send them a collaboration invite directly from your control panel.

calendarActivation.title: Calendar activation
calendarActivation.description: Once accepted, they automatically get their own work calendar.

validation.helpTitle: Don't worry, the process is very simple!
validation.helpSubtitle: You'll find a full video guide and step-by-step support in the app as soon as you log in.
